data.name: Fahdah
data.gender_notes: Fahdah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fahdah is an Arabic name which means 'gracious' and 'generous'. It has Quranic origins and is used for both girls and boys. The name Fahdah carries the meaning “Gracious, Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Fahdah usually hope their child will grow to embody gracious, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: This name embodies the Islamic virtue of generosity and kindness towards others.
data.etymology: Fahdah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gracious, Generous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fahdah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: فهدة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم فهدة يعني الفتى الحسن الجميل
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فهدة مشتق من الفهد، وهو الحيوان المعروف بسرعته وجماله، ويرمز الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية إلى السرعة والخفة والجمال، وقد ورد ذكر الفهد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفرقان الآية ٢، حيث يقول الله تعالى: «وَالَّذِينَ يَسْعَونَ فِي آيَاتِنَا مُعَاجِزِينَ أُولَئِكَ فِي الْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ»

in_urdu.name: فہدہ
in_urdu.meaning: فہدہ نام کا مطلب خوبصورت اور تیز رفتار ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: فہدہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس میں 'فہد' کے معنی ہیں فهد یا تیز رفتار جانور، یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں خوبصورتی، تیز رفتاری اور چستی کے مفہوم کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، یہ نام جنوب ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں مقبول ہے

in_hindi.name: फहदह
in_hindi.meaning: फहदह नाम का अर्थ सुंदर और तेज़ है
in_hindi.long_meaning: फहदह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है फाहद या तेज़ गति वाला जानवर, यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में सुंदरता, गति और चपलता को दर्शाता है, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में लोकप्रिय है

in_pashto.name: فهدة
in_pashto.meaning: فهدة نوم معنی یې ښکلی او چټک دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: فهدة نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې په کې 'فهد' معنی لري فهد یا چټک حيوان، دا نوم د اسلامي کلتور کې ښکلا، چټکتیا او چابکۍ مفهوم څرګندوي، دا نوم د افغان او پښتنو په دود کې کارول کیږي

in_english.name: Fahdah
in_english.meaning: Fahdah means beautiful and swift in English
in_english.long_meaning: The name Fahdah originates from Arabic roots, derived from 'fahd' which means cheetah or swift creature, symbolizing beauty, speed, and agility in Islamic culture, referenced in Quranic context for its swift nature, historically used across Muslim cultures to signify elegance and quick wit

data.cultural_impact: The name Fahdah holds a significant cultural impact as it's associated with the trait of being gracious and generous. In Islamic culture, hospitality and generosity towards guests are highly valued virtues. By giving their child the name Fahdah, parents are hoping that their child will grow up to embody these traits and contribute to building strong family and community relationships.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the name Fahdah signifies the person's qualities of being kind, compassionate, and merciful. These qualities are central to the teachings of Islam. The name Fahdah can serve as a daily reminder for the individual to strive towards being a blessing to others and acting with kindness and graciousness in all aspects of their life. The name also carries a subtle encouragement for individuals to practice generosity and be of service to those in need, as featured in the Hadith and teachings of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him).
data.spiritual_symbolism: Fahdah: Swiftness in seeking and attaining knowledge and wisdom. A beacon of light in the pursuit of truth, guiding others with unwavering determination and speed.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Fahdah bint Al-Qasim Al-Thaqafi was a famous poetess from the pre-Islamic era. The name Fahdah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Fahdah was a prominent figure in pre-Islamic Arabian poetry.

trends: Popular choice for newborns in Muslim communities
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Fahdah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Fatima Fahdah in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Fahdah, which means "Gracious, Generous". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
